name: upgraditch
description: Browser extension that shows up when you are tempted to replace a phone that still works

scripts.package:source: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'package:source: commit first, the source zip is made from git (HEAD)' >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && git archive --format=zip -o web-ext-artifacts/source.zip HEAD
scripts.sign:firefox: web-ext sign --source-dir dist --channel listed --amo-metadata store/amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code web-ext-artifacts/source.zip
